name: marker-highlight
description: Display text settles in, then one hand-drawn marker stroke (highlight, circle, underline, or scribble) draws over the emphasized word on cue.

vars.description: First case-insensitive substring match in text receives the marker. Empty or unmatched draws no marker.
Shape of the hand-drawn marker stroke.
Second (from mount start) the marker starts drawing. Clamped so the stroke completes before any exit.
Marker ink color from the contract token map.
Optional departure. Default none: the lockup holds until the frame cuts.
